title: Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards Loss Protection Schedule
content:
Every card type in the Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards program can be registered to a customer profile, is replaced free of charge when lost or stolen, protects only the balance remaining when the loss is reported, and has its fraud review completed within 10 business days. The types differ in what is needed to replace a lost or stolen card, and in whether the balance can be moved to another card of the same holder.

## Schedule by card type

| Card type | Can be registered to a customer profile | Needed to replace a lost or stolen card | Fee to replace a lost or stolen card (USD) | Balance protected on replacement | Business days a fraud review of a frozen card may take | Balance can be moved to another card of the same holder |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Gift Card | yes | registration, or the purchase receipt showing the card number | 0.00 | the balance at the time the loss is reported | 10 | no |
| Northgate eGift Card | yes | registration, or the purchase receipt showing the card number | 0.00 | the balance at the time the loss is reported | 10 | no |
| Northgate Merchandise Return Card | yes | registration, or the purchase receipt showing the card number | 0.00 | the balance at the time the loss is reported | 10 | no |
| Northgate Promotional Gift Card | yes | registration | 0.00 | the balance at the time the loss is reported | 10 | no |
| Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card | yes | registration, or the purchase receipt showing the card number | 0.00 | the balance at the time the loss is reported | 10 | no |
| Northgate Reloadable Gift Card | yes | registration | 0.00 | the balance at the time the loss is reported | 10 | yes |

## What the replacement column means in practice

| Hypothetical holder position | Type needing registration or receipt | Type needing registration |
|---|---|---|
| card registered | replaceable | replaceable |
| card not registered, purchase receipt showing the card number held | replaceable | not replaceable |
| card not registered, no such receipt | not replaceable | not replaceable |

## Note on balance moves

Moving a balance onto another card of the same holder, for combining or replacing, is open only on the Northgate Reloadable Gift Card.
